annotations.title: Update a hack with the update TrackerHacker worked out, or turn it down

description: When a hack stops matching, TrackerHacker works out an update for it (draftedFix in check_tracks) that waits for the person in To do, where the buttons are Update the hack and Not now. Only when the person tells you to, in this conversation: use it (draftedFix says how many of the waiting messages it reads), which also runs the Inbox again so they become rows (inbox says how many); or turn it down, keeping the hack as it is. Never in a scheduled or unattended run: report that it's waiting instead.

hackId.description: The stopped hack, from check_tracks or list_tracks.

use.description: true updates the hack, false turns the update down (Not now).
